offense.name: Pass
offense.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, ball speed +2.

offense.name: Pass and Run
offense.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, passer moves forward 1.

offense.name: Curved Pass
offense.effect: Ball to a teammate 0-2 spaces away.

offense.name: Pinpoint
offense.effect:
Ball to a teammate up to 3 spaces away. Ball speed +3.
Failed: after stealing, the defender may Pass unopposed.

offense.name: Dribble
offense.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Ball speed +2.

offense.name: Advance
offense.effect: Player and ball move forward up to 2 spaces.

offense.name: Spin
offense.effect: Change ball speed by up to oSkill. A teammate in the zone moves up to 2 spaces.

offense.name: Drive
offense.effect: Player and ball to closest teammate ahead or behind. Teammate may take the ball. Ball speed -2.

offense.name: Burst
offense.effect:
Player and ball move up to 4 spaces. Ball speed to 12.
Failed: lose possession, ball speed does not reset.

offense.name: High Ball
offense.effect: Ball forward 3 spaces, receiver must win a contest, then may set up scoring.

offense.name: Long shot
offense.effect: Ball to striker, must win a contest to receive and then set up scoring.

offense.name: Set up
offense.effect: ball forward 2 spaces, may set up scoring.

offense.name: Vertical Ball
offense.effect: Ball 0-1 spaces, may set up a scoring.

offense.name: Cross
offense.effect:
Successful gambit: Set up scoring  0-3 spaces away (with speed bonus).
Failed gambit: opponent auto wins a contest to get the deflected ball.

defense.name: Deflect
defense.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If reaches goal zone, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1. If Fullback ball moves an additional space.

defense.name: Follow
defense.effect: Ball moves back 1 space, defender follows it. If reaches goal zone, may set up scoring.

defense.name: Boot
defense.effect: Ball moves back 2 spaces. If reaches the goal zone, not set up scoring.

defense.name: Block
defense.effect: The ball is contested on the spot.

defense.name: Clear
defense.effect:
Successful gambit: ball moves back 3. If reaches the goal zone may set up scoring. Ball speed -3.
Failed gambit: exhaust 2.

defense.name: Steal
defense.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Manipulate ball speed after turnover (up to dSkill).

defense.name: My Turf!
defense.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Defenders and midfielders gain +3 to contest.

defense.name: Toss
defense.effect: Turnover. Ball to the nearest teammate behind the defender.

defense.name: Intercept
defense.effect:
Successful gambit: turnover. Defender and ball move forward 1. Adjust ball speed after turnover (up to dSkill).
Failed gambit: High Ball reception is uncontested.

defense.name: Pressure
defense.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches the goal zone, risk own goal.

defense.name: Control
defense.effect: If the defender is a Defender, turnover. Otherwise, Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If reaches goal zone, own goal risk.

defense.name: Stress
defense.effect: Ball to handler's nearest teammate behind. Defender follows. If reaches the goal zone, risk own goal.

defense.name: Double Team
defense.effect:
Successful gambit: player and ball go back 1; Defender moves 1 forward and nearest teammate behind joins, gaining Merge for the next defensive maneuver. If reaches the goal zone, own goal risk.
Failed gambit: Defender and nearest teammate behind go 1 forward.
